title: Interaction
description: What a permission request asks of the person beyond leave to run a tool, normalised by the adapter of the engine (plan 24; plan 28, B-20): a `question` — the questions the agent asks, with their options — or a `plan` to approve before the agent changes anything. A client renders this and never reads the raw input.

kind.description: `question` — the agent asks something and waits for the answers; `plan` — the agent presents a plan, approved or refused with a reason. A client that meets another value shows the generic card.

malformed.description: On `question`: the input could not be read safely — no questions or more than four, fewer than two or more than four options, an option with no label, a question with no options, a question repeated, a label repeated within a question. `questions` is then empty, the card offers only a refusal, and an `allow` is refused with `PERMISSION_ANSWERS_INVALID`.

questions.description: One to four, in the order the agent asked them; empty when `malformed`.

id.description: `q1`…`q4`, by position — stable within the request, and what an answer names.

header.description: The short chip of the question (engines ask for a short one; the model does not always obey). Cut, never refused.

prompt.description: The question itself, as the agent wrote it. Text to show, never markup. Cut, never refused.

multiSelect.description: Several options may be chosen. A single choice is one label, or the free answer (`other`).

options.description: What the agent offers. The free answer ("Other") is not here: the screen offers it.

label.description: Shown and answered exactly as it is — a label ending in "(Recommended)" keeps it, and a screen may highlight it but never pre-select it.

preview.description: A mockup or a snippet, in markdown, rendered with the safe renderer — never HTML. Absent when the option has none.

markdown.description: The plan, in markdown, on `plan`. Text to render safely, never markup to trust.

path.description: The file the agent saved the plan to, on `plan`, when it says.

x-required-when.because: a question says whether it could be read, so a screen never offers half of what was asked
a question is its questions — empty only when malformed
a plan to approve is its text; approving one nobody could read is what the card exists to prevent
